notes: Self-owned static input fixtures; none is executed by the service or metadata tests.
System libraries and SDKs are link-time dependencies, not redistributed in these files.
The Objective-C linker merges category methods into their class metadata; synthetic byte fixtures separately exercise unmerged category records.
Swift reflection contains relative symbolic type references with embedded NUL bytes; these remain escaped opaque mangled text, not recovered source types.
The generated PDB is an ignored build intermediate; only its embedded CodeView identity reference is tested. No PDB type recovery or automatic PDB access is implied.
Compiler/SDK/linker changes can change hashes and identities. Hashes identify the checked-in inputs, not a universal reproducible-build guarantee.
